text: Two different 'no DR' stories must never be merged. (1) 'No paper DR' / dl_branches.paperless_dr_enabled, per branch: stock already on hand but never written down (missed/undercounted) -> enables adjustment_add; cashier+supervisor follow the switch, admin always. (2) 'Own production' / dl_branches.has_production + dl_branch_products.allow_own_production ('Makes it'), per product: the branch MADE the item so no supplier DR exists -> enables own_production. Neither grants the other, and own_production must NOT consult paperless_dr_enabled; the original switch implementation did gate own_production and that conflation is what left a cake box unrecordable.
